OCPP16-ERR-GroundFailure.title: Ground failure fault
OCPP16-ERR-GroundFailure.text: A ground failure means current is leaking somewhere it should not go, so the charger stops the session as a safety precaution. The connector should stay out of service until a technician inspects the grounding and cabling.
OCPP16-ERR-GroundFailure.source: agent draft — human to verify against OCPP 1.6
